label: Adagrasib + cetuximab approved (FDA)
detail: Accelerated approval in KRAS G12C colorectal cancer, with cetuximab; this is the indication withdrawn on 1 Sep 2026

label: Avutometinib + defactinib approved (FDA)
detail: Accelerated approval in KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer after prior systemic therapy; a RAF/MEK clamp plus a FAK inhibitor, so the indication rather than the mechanism is defined by KRAS mutation (Table 2 note 9)

label: NMPA approvals 2024-2025
detail: Fulzerasib 2024-08; garsorasib 2024-11-08; glecirasib 2025-05 (ORR 47.9%, 95% CI 38.5-57.3) - each a conditional approval with a confirmatory obligation; the fourth NMPA G12C approval, sosimerasib (February 2026), is filed as its own row below
source: NMPA 2024-2025; Shi Y 2025 Nat Med; Yuan Y 2025 STTT

label: Daraxonrasib approved (FDA)
detail: RASolute 302; first approval in the RAS(ON) multi-selective lane; treated metastatic PDAC
source: FDA 2026-08-26; Wolpin BM 2026 NEJM; O'Reilly EM 2026 NEJM

label: Sosimerasib approved (NMPA)
detail: Conditional approval for KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC after at least one systemic therapy, on a single-arm phase 2 study (145 patients, ORR 52.4%; ChiCTR2200059986); the fourth NMPA G12C approval; library papers predate the event (GH35 is a different molecule)
source: NMPA approval 2026-02-25, announced 2026-02-28 (official reprint, NMPA original page not retrieved); Zhong et al. 2025 JCO via Riedl JM 2026

label: Adagrasib + cetuximab withdrawn
detail: Accelerated approval 21 Jun 2024; withdrawn 1 Sep 2026 after confirmatory KRYSTAL-10 failed to show benefit

label: Divarasib phase 3 vs first-generation
detail: Randomised phase 3 against the first-generation inhibitors (control: 156 sotorasib, 15 adagrasib), crossover not permitted; PFS 9.8 vs 5.7 months (HR 0.58, 0.44-0.76), OS 17.7 vs 12.0 months (HR 0.56, 0.41-0.78)
